name: Workspaces
description: Up to five desks on your computers (a phone keeps its own tabs), each with its own tabs, panels and pinned pages, numbered in the sidebar's header like a tiling window manager's: switch with ⌃1 to ⌃5 (Alt+1 to Alt+5 off a Mac) or a two-finger swipe over the sidebar. Each can have an icon, a colour the sidebars take, a Browser container its web pages open in and a machine its terminals start on. All tabs (⌃0) shows every workspace's. Off, there's one setup.
